info.title: csv-exporter
info.description: Converts a list of JSON records into a downloadable CSV file. Nested objects are flattened into dotted column names, lists are joined with ';', and text values starting with =, +, - or @ are prefixed with ' to prevent formula injection.

400.description: Invalid request. error is EMPTY_DATA when data is an empty list, and INVALID_INPUT for every other problem (body not JSON, not an object, data not a list of objects, columns not a list of strings).

data.description: Records to convert. Each object becomes one CSV row; the header is the union of all keys in first-seen order.

columns.description: Optional. Which columns to include, in this order. Use dotted names for nested fields (e.g. address.city).

filename.description: Optional. Filename returned in the Content-Disposition header.

error.description: EMPTY_DATA when data is an empty list; INVALID_INPUT for all other bad requests.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what is wrong.

example.message: data must have at least one record
